summary: Declare Transcript and Workbench stories as host-owned contract fixtures and remove their deferred scenario-mode debt

replay.detail: Story scenario classification only; no replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client behavior changes. Transcript and Workbench story args, render and play remain unchanged. Scenario-driven Transcript stories for wire-expressible families are tracked in https://github.com/compoundingtech/fractal/issues/3821.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
